facts.business: GP Petroleums Limited formulates, manufactures, and markets industrial lubricants, automotive lubricants, rubber process oils, transformer oils, greases, and other specialties under the brand 'IPOL', and also operates in base oil trading and bitumen businesses.
key_risks: Fluctuations in crude oil and base oil prices
Provision for doubtful debts on long-outstanding trade receivables under legal dispute or arbitration
facts.related_party_note: The Company has an exclusive alliance with REPSOL since 2016 for manufacturing REPSOL lubricants at its Vasai plant. It also has a partnership with Honda for Honda-Repsol co-branded lubricants for the motorcycle and scooter segment. During FY 2025-26, the Company entered into a Joint Venture Agreement with West Coast Oils LLP and acquired a 50% equity stake in Amron Oil Resources Private Limited.
